# Niwa Day

> A free Windows desktop app that displays your Google Calendar as a floating vertical timeline — today's schedule, quietly in view.

Niwa Day (庭 — Japanese for "garden") is a lightweight productivity tool for Windows. It connects to Google Calendar via read-only OAuth 2.0, renders today's events as a floating timeline, and lets you layer in personal routines alongside your calendar events. A real-time indicator tracks the current moment throughout the day.

Key facts:
- Free to download from the Microsoft Store
- Windows only
- Read-only Google Calendar access (no write permissions)
- No analytics or telemetry collected
- Developer: Jimmy Chen (Taiwan)
